## SpotifyClient interface

The Spotify client: one namespace per resource that has operations, plus the app's own commands. A client factory creates one from `spotifyContract` in the app's `/contract` entry. Its type carries the contract's resource table, [SpotifyResources](./spotify_contract.spotifyresources.md)<!-- -->, so references can be bound to it by resource; the brand has no runtime member.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface SpotifyClient extends ClientBrand<SpotifyResources>
```

**Extends:** [ClientBrand](./contracts.clientbrand.md)<!-- -->&lt;[SpotifyResources](./spotify_contract.spotifyresources.md)<!-- -->&gt;
